name: build-brief
description: Compile plain-language software intent into an implementation-ready design contract before coding.

interface.shortDescription: Translate software intent into precise build commands.
interface.longDescription: Build Brief automatically recognizes non-trivial software requests, reads the actual codebase, and completes a proportional design contract before implementation. Users can let it build automatically, review the contract first, or request a handoff-ready directive without coding.
defaultPrompt: Compile an implementation-ready design contract for this request, then build it.
Show me the design contract first and wait for approval before coding.
Turn this request into a handoff-ready engineering directive without coding.
